snippet.title: Paris Jackson Says Bond With Dad Michael Jackson Is "No One's Business" | E! News
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson’s daughter Paris Jackson has a message for her critics. The “Let Down” singer—who was 11 years old when the King of Pop died in 2009—shared that she no longer feels pressure to tell the world about the connection she had with her dad. In the past, Paris admitted she felt an expectation to publicly commemorate Michael—also dad to Prince, 29, and Bigi "Blanket," 24—on his birthday, death day and Father’s Day. "I'm now learning I can have my own personal relationship and I'm allowed to be private about it,” Paris said on the May 26 episode of the 'Trying Not to Die' podcast. “I'm now like, my relationship is the most beautiful relationship ever.” The 28-year-old added of her mindset shift, “I'm in a very beautiful spot with my dad and I love that and it's no one's business and I don't have to share that with anybody. And there's a lot of freedom in that, which is really cool." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1432360/michael-jacksons-daughter-paris-jackson-details-relationship-privacy

snippet.title: Paris Jackson on Speaking at Dad Michael's Memorial and Not Meeting Mom Debbie Rowe Until She Was 15
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson opens up about life as Michael Jackson's only daughter. While on 'Call Her Daddy,' the 28-year-old calls the late singer her best friend, and reflects on her headline-making speech at his memorial service, which she gave when she was only 11 years old. She reveals the emotional moment wasn't planned; she stepped up to speak only when her brothers, Prince and Bigi (aka Blanket) didn't. She also shares her experience of meeting biological mom Debbie Rowe for the first time at 15, and her nearly lifelong battle with addiction.

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Reveals Childhood Secrets #shorts #parisjackson #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson Reveals Childhood Secrets #shorts #parisjackson #michaeljackson 

Paris Jackson is opening up about what life was really like growing up as the daughter of Michael Jackson. In a candid conversation with Jack Osbourne, Paris reflected on her unusual childhood, revealing that she was homeschooled for much of her early life and struggled to connect with kids her own age after spending most of her time around adults and her father's friends.

The singer and actress also addressed the pressure she feels from fans to publicly mourn and celebrate Michael Jackson online, explaining that her relationship with her father was personal rather than parasocial. Paris pushed back against assumptions that she relies on her father's legacy or wealth, insisting that she works hard for everything she has achieved. She also discussed being labeled a "nepo baby," emphasizing that Michael Jackson taught his children the importance of earning success through strong work ethic and dedication.

Now pursuing her own career in music and entertainment, Paris says she remains committed to building her own path while continuing to honor her father's legacy in her own way.

snippet.title: Why Paris Jackson Is Slamming a New Michael Jackson Biopic
snippet.description:

The estimated $155 million production is not getting the stamp of approval from Jackson’s 27-year-old daughter, Paris, who says it’s full of inaccuracies. "I just prefer honesty over, like, sales and monetary gain," she says. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda repots for TODAY.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Daughter Paris Jackson Details Meeting Her Mom at 15 | E! News
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson—who was primarily raised by her dad Michael Jackson until his 2009 death—detailed the moment she met her mom Debbie Rowe for the first time when she was 15 years old. During an Aug. 12 appearance on Call Her Daddy, the 28-year-old recalled the surprisingly casual encounter, sharing that she simply greeted Debbie with, “Hey, mom,” before the two spent the day together. Paris said she called Rowe “mom” right away and revealed they bonded over their similarities, including both being fire signs—Paris an Aries and Rowe a Sagittarius. The 67-year-old is also the biological mother of Paris’ older brother Prince Jackson, 29. Michael is also dad to son Bigi Jackson, 24, who was born via surrogate. Paris, Prince and Bigi were primarily raised by the King of Pop before his death in 2009 at age 50, with Paris later reconnecting with Debbie as a teenager and developing a closer relationship with her over the years. snippet.title: Paris Jackson Reveals Her Favorite Michael Jackson Songs ❤ #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
What were Paris Jackson’s favorite Michael Jackson songs growing up? 🎶❤️

In this rare interview, Paris shares intimate memories of growing up with her father, Michael Jackson.

Although she and her brother Prince didn’t realize just how famous their dad was, they spent their childhood dancing, prancing around and building pillow forts while listening to his iconic Off the Wall album.

Paris also reveals two of her favorite songs: “The Lost Children” and “Whatever Happens,” featuring Carlos Santana.

Paris rarely shares these kinds of personal memories today, making this interview a special glimpse into life behind the scenes with the King of Pop.

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Finally Breaks Silence On Her Real Father
snippet.description:
In a powerful and emotional moment that has taken the internet by storm, Paris Jackson has finally broken her silence to permanently address the intense public speculation surrounding her true parentage and biological heritage. For years, critics pointed toward her blue eyes, pale skin, and blonde hair to question her birth certificate, a mystery further fueled by cryptic statements from Debbie Rowe and outside claims from individuals like Mark Lester and Arnold Klein. Setting the record straight once and for all, Paris completely rejected the media rumors, proudly stating that Michael Jackson raised her, loved her, and taught her exactly who she is. Emphasizing that she proudly considers herself Black and refuses to let strangers define her identity, Paris delivered a beautiful message to the world, proving that love, presence, and devotion are the ultimate things that make someone a real parent.

snippet.title: Paris Jackson’s $600 Million Battle Over Her Father’s Fortune
snippet.description:
On October 29, 2026, Paris Jackson filed a petition in the Los Angeles County Superior Court concerning the financial management of the Estate of Michael Jackson.
The court filing requests a judicial order requiring long-serving estate executors John Branca and John McClain to disburse $600 million into the Michael Jackson Family Trust, an entity established to support Jackson's three children and designated charities. The petition contends that formal distribution to the trust has faced prolonged delays since 2009, despite substantial revenue from commercial catalog agreements, theatrical productions, and digital licensing.
Representatives for the executors maintain that ongoing federal tax assessments and administrative obligations govern the timing of final distributions, with legal proceedings ongoing.
